troubleshooting.title: Autosave Fails When Document Focus Changes

condition.title: Problem
condition.p: If does not automatically save the document when you close the tab, close the browser, use the browser Back or Forward buttons, or navigate to another topic from the DITA Map view, the document autosave process might fail in older versions.

cause.title: Cause
cause.p: Versions older than 29 use a browser feature that recent browser versions no longer support. Because of this change, Web Author might not save the document when the page focus changes or when you leave the current topic.
